task: Phase 12 backlog item 'Verify system API surface for future third-party/LLM controller plugins' (design-docs/plans/active/master_agnostic_tasks.md line 96). Audited docs/studio-as-tts-gateway.md + design-docs/specs/api-conventions.md against app/api/tts_api.py for adequacy as a third-party/LLM-controller-facing gateway (discover engines/voices, submit job, poll status, retrieve result, consistent auth/errors). Found the surface itself adequate (all four capabilities present, errors structured/consistent, URL+version-field versioning adequate). Found and fixed one real, verifiable auth gap: the sub-app's auto-generated /docs and /openapi routes bypassed verify_api_key/rate_limit entirely, contradicting design-docs/specs/api-conventions.md's existing 'All routes require verify_api_key + rate_limit' contract.

app/api/tts_api.py.summary: S12 fix: FastAPI's auto-generated docs_url/openapi_url/redoc_url routes are registered via add_route() (plain Starlette routing), which bypasses FastAPI's dependency-injection system -- so the `dependencies=[Depends(verify_api_key), Depends(rate_limit)]` passed to the FastAPI() constructor never applied to /api/v1/tts/docs or /api/v1/tts/openapi. Confirmed empirically pre-fix: both returned 200 with no Authorization header, and even when tts_api_enabled=False. Fix: disabled docs_url/openapi_url/redoc_url on the FastAPI() constructor and added explicit GET /openapi and GET /docs routes on `router` (which is include_router'd into the sub-app and therefore inherits the same verify_api_key + rate_limit dependencies as every data route, e.g. /engines, /synthesize, /jobs/{id}). Verified: 401 unauthenticated, 403 when tts_api_enabled=False, 200 with a valid key -- matching every other route's behavior.

tests/api/test_api_tts_api.py.summary: Added 4 real tests hitting the actual mounted sub-app via TestClient(app): test_docs_requires_auth, test_openapi_requires_auth, test_docs_rejected_when_api_disabled (all revert-checked red against the pre-fix code per testing-standards.md R1: stashed app/api/tts_api.py, ran the 4 new tests, saw 3 fail with assert 200 == ..., restored the fix), and test_docs_and_openapi_accessible_with_valid_key confirming the routes still function correctly for an authenticated caller.
